```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sp)
library(ks)
```

## Data Preparation

```{r data-preparation}
data <- read.csv("path/to/your/data.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(variable_of_interest)) %>%
  mutate(new_variable = ifelse(condition, true_value, false_value))
```

## Standardization Procedures

```{r standardization}
standardized_data <- scale(data$variable_of_interest)
data$standardized_variable <- standardized_data
```

## KDE Calculations

```{r kde}
kde_result <- kde(data$coordinates)
```

## Figure Generation

```{r figures}
ggplot(data, aes(x = x_variable, y = y_variable)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_density_2d() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="KDE of Non-breeding Distributions")
```
